model_source_account.interpretation: The model returned an edit report, not the required structured donor-source account. Preserve this failure independently of executable code and reviewer provenance evidence.

retained_behavior.source_distinguishing_detail: Only TestStatus.PASSED.value enters the original-passing inventory; XFAIL is expressly excluded.
retained_behavior.relationship: The unchanged inherited mechanism selects only parsed PASSED items and requires nonempty complete classification coverage.

retained_behavior.source_distinguishing_detail: Checks current observed outcomes against the original regression_tests PASS_TO_PASS inventory.
retained_behavior.relationship: Inherited code compares candidate observations against frozen base inventory, with explicit target-side obligation and completeness adaptations.

dependency_boundary: Historical get_logs_eval/get_eval_tests_report behavior is replaced by package-owned native parsing; the historical SWE-bench dependency stack is not reconstructed.
Datasets, jsonlines, donor filesystem reads and donor runner orchestration are replaced by declared JSON events, returned state and generic isolated execution effects.
The host does not supply inventory, parsed outcomes, obligation judgments or substantive G feedback.
target_adaptations: Whole-base completeness and nonempty PASSED inventory validation.
Human-supplied evidence-linked three-state obligations and exact expected-assertion ownership.
Exact generic snapshot/projection/receipt transport and within-loop feedback instead of offline ranking.
Guard FileIdentity/null semantics retained from the prior target-interface repair.
New public native transcript grammar and package-owned parser implementation.
independent_source_account.account_authorship: Independent reviewer; not the failed model source_judgments submission.

semantic_change_observations.observation: Collection display is optional; recognized present counts remain unique and checked against actual status rows. Prefixed collecting display, unfinished collection, duplicate IDs and terminal/status mismatch handling are implemented locally.

Maintains explicit pending parent identities, resolves standalone native status only when ownership is unique, records overlap/orphan/unfinished diagnostics and does not treat uppercase OK as a parent status.
New owner helper maps detail header suffixes back toward displayed parent identity; this is a semantic change beyond collection/pending parsing.
Chooses complete standalone or combined parses and compares observations/details for selected equivalence; this is a semantic change beyond the two reported syntax defects.
Predicate AST is unchanged, but its upstream parsed details and selected stream changed, so full assertion-behavior equivalence cannot be inferred from that AST identity alone.

static_code_review.behavior_validation_owner: Independent evaluator; not this static source review.

projection_scope: Independent source/static audit fields only; no completed generation response, private entry, hidden acceptance payload, benchmark patch or grade log.
